name: staff-workspace-runtime-audit

notes: Confirmed post-create runtime failure: StaffManagement stores the raw GraphQL StaffPrivateProfile as selectedEmployee, so EmployeeDetail attempts to render the structured address object as a React child before the list mapping effect can normalize it.
